title: سَيْفْ وَمَرْمَى الْإِنْدُومِي
summary: سَيْفْ رَايِحْ يِلْعَبْ كُرَةَ قَدَمْ مَعْ أَخُوه هَاشِمْ فِي صَالَةِ الْأَلْعَابْ. بِيِبْنُوا مَرْمَى مِنْ قِطَعْ طَرِيِّة، بَسّْ هَاشِمْ بِحَوِّلْ الْقِطْعَة الصَّفْرَا لِإِنْدُومِي خَيَالِيِّة. سَيْفْ بِفَرْجِيه اللُّعْبِة بِحَرَكِة وَاضْحَة، وَبِتْصِيرْ إِلْهُم لَعْبِة وَضِحِكْ مَعْ بَعْضْ. آخِرْ الْمَشْوَارْ، بِقْعُدُوا جَنْبْ مَامَا وَبِيِكَمِّلُوا نُكْتِة الْإِنْدُومِي بِصَوْتْ وَاطِي.
dedication: لِسَيْفْ، وَلِضِحْكِتُه اللِّي بِتِعْمَلْ مَكَانْ لِلْكُلّْ.
character_brief: General fictional eight-year-old Jordanian boy, not a claimed likeness: slim medium-height build, olive skin, short softly wavy dark brown hair, dark brown expressive eyes, cream crew-neck T-shirt, deep teal joggers, berry-red grip socks, no shoes indoors. Rounded gentle painterly features, natural proportions, approximately 130 cm tall.
supporting_character_brief: Hashim is a fictional three-year-old Jordanian boy, approximately 95 cm tall, with olive skin, short dark brown curls, round cheeks and dark brown eyes. He always wears a mustard-gold short-sleeved T-shirt, cream trousers and deep teal grip socks. His toddler proportions remain distinct from Saif's.

visual_continuity.characters: Saif and Hashim keep their exact briefs and outfits. Their mother is an adult Jordanian woman with olive skin, dark brown eyes and dark brown hair in a low bun, wearing a long berry-red blouse, loose cream trousers and deep teal grip socks. She is present and watching throughout, seated nearby on the bench until the boys join her on page 8. Never make Hashim a peer or give the two brothers matching outfits.
visual_continuity.locations: One plausible generic Amman indoor play room, not a claim about any named venue's actual layout. Cream plaster rear wall, deep teal padded lower wall, tall arched window at physical left, warm cream floor mat with a muted teal border. A low cream padded bench stands along the rear wall, beneath a small round unlettered gold wall light. The low foam goal stands in front of that bench, facing the open foreground. Use this geography and warm afternoon light on every page; backgrounds stay calm rather than adding new play equipment.
visual_continuity.objects: Exactly one soft football, cream-white with five dark teal pentagonal patches visible depending on angle, diameter about 18 cm; no lettering or logos. Exactly three goal components: two identical deep teal foam cubes, each about 25 cm tall, and one smooth mustard-gold foam bar, approximately 70 cm long and 8 cm thick with rounded ends. The cubes are spaced with a clear ball-sized opening between them, the bar rests across their tops to make a low pretend goal, never a load-bearing climbing structure. No extra ball, extra cubes, extra bar or actual food. Hashim only pretends the foam bar is a noodle.
visual_continuity.timeline: One warm afternoon, with window light from physical left and the same palette throughout. Page 1 introduces the single football and the three goal pieces still loose on the mat. Page 2 Saif assembles the low goal. Page 3 Hashim removes its yellow bar and carries it loosely across his shoulders, leaving only the two teal cubes standing. Page 4 Saif gently rolls the ball between those cubes while the bar is still with Hashim. Page 5 the boys put the bar back and learn the keeper stance. Page 6 Hashim sits in that complete goal and hugs the rolled ball. Page 7 the brothers swap roles, and the one ball rolls through Saif's legs into the goal. Page 8 Hashim holds that same ball on the bench beside Saif and their mother; the complete goal remains on the mat nearby. Nothing is magically repaired or multiplied between frames.

cover.illustration_description: General fictional Saif and toddler Hashim in the anchored cream-and-teal indoor play room, amused beside one low pretend goal of two teal foam cubes and one mustard-gold foam bar, with one cream-and-teal football. Mother watches near the rear bench. Warm afternoon window light; upper 40% calm cream wall for the title.

pages.text: فِي صَالَةِ الْأَلْعَابْ، كَانْ سَيْفْ نَاوِي يِشُوتْ كُرَةَ الْقَدَمْ وَيِجِيبْ هَدَفْ. لَوَّحْ لِمَامَا اللِّي قَاعْدَة قُرْبُه: «بَاي، مَامَا!» ابْتَسَمِتْ وَرَدَّتْ: «يَلَّا، أَنَا شَايْفِتَكْ!»
pages.illustration_description: Wide opening view of Saif waving cheerfully to mother on the rear cream bench, toddler Hashim beside him. One cream-and-teal football and three loose goal pieces rest on the mat. Arched window at physical left, warm afternoon light. All action is in the upper 70%; lower 30% calm.

pages.text: حَطّْ سَيْفْ مُكَعَّبَيْنْ طَرِيِّينْ أَخْضَرَيْنْ، وَفَوْقْهُمَا قِطْعَة صَفْرَا، وَعَمِلْ مَرْمَى صْغِيرْ. قَالْ لِهَاشِمْ: «خَلِّيكْ حَارِسْ، وَأَنَا بَشُوتْ». هَاشِمْ هَزّْ رَاسُه، وَعَيْنُه عَالْقِطْعَة الصَّفْرَا.
pages.illustration_description: Medium view of kneeling Saif setting the one rounded mustard-gold foam bar across two teal cubes, forming a low goal. Hashim watches that bar curiously; the single football rests beside Saif. Mother and bench remain behind, arched window at physical left. Upper 70% action, lower 30% calm.

pages.text: بَسّْ بَدَلْ مَا يِوَقِّفْ بِالْمَرْمَى، شَالْ هَاشِمْ الْقِطْعَة الصَّفْرَا وَحَطَّهَا عَكَتِفُه. «إِنْدُومِي كْبِيرَة!» صَاحْ وَهُوَّ بِضْحَكْ. وِقِفْ سَيْفْ وَالْكُرَة تَحْتْ رِجْلُه، وَنَفَخْ خْدُودُه.
pages.illustration_description: Closer playful frame: toddler Hashim carries the single mustard-gold foam bar loosely across his shoulders, pretending it is a giant noodle. Saif puffs his cheeks, one socked foot gently on the football. Behind them only two teal goal cubes remain. Mother is nearby. Upper 70% action, lower 30% calm.

pages.text: فَتَحْ سَيْفْ تِمُّه عَشَانْ يِعِيدْ كَلَامُه، بَسّْ شَافْ هَاشِمْ عَمْ يِعْمَلْ حَالُه طَبَّاخْ. ابْتَسَمْ، وَقَعَدْ قُرْبُه، وَفَرْجَاه كِيفْ بِتِمُرّْ الْكُرَة بِهُدُوءْ بَيْنْ الْمُكَعَّبَيْنْ.
pages.illustration_description: Medium low viewpoint: Saif smiles at Hashim at toddler eye level and rolls the one football between the two teal cubes, showing the game. Hashim watches while holding the mustard-gold bar off to his side, not atop the goal. Mother remains by the bench. Upper 70% action, lower 30% calm.

pages.text: رَجَّعُوا الْقِطْعَة الصَّفْرَا فَوْقْ الْمُكَعَّبَيْنْ، وَوِقِفْ سَيْفْ قُدَّامْ الْمَرْمَى. «شُوفْ، بْنِفْتَحْ إِيدَيْنَا هَيْكْ!» هَاشِمْ قَلَّدُه، وَبِضِحْكِة قَالْ: «أَنَا الْحَارِسْ!» مَامَا ضَلِّتْ قُرْبْهُمْ تِتْفَرَّجْ.
pages.illustration_description: Medium front view of Saif demonstrating a keeper stance with open hands, Hashim copying him beside the complete low foam goal. Its one gold bar is restored across two teal cubes. One football rests nearby; mother smiles on the rear cream bench. Upper 70% action, lower 30% calm.

pages.text: بَعَدْ سَيْفْ خُطْوَتَيْنْ، وَدَحْرَجْ الْكُرَة بِرِجْلُه بِخِفِّة. قَعَدْ هَاشِمْ بِالْمَرْمَى وَحَضَنَهَا، بَسّْ طَلَعْ مَعَه صَوْتْ «هِهْ هِهْ!» الْكُرَة دَغْدَغِتْ بَطْنُه، وَالْحَارِسْ نِسِي يِوَقِّفْ ضَحِكْ!
pages.illustration_description: Close expression view of toddler Hashim seated in front of the complete teal-and-gold foam goal, hugging the single cream-and-teal football against his tummy and giggling. Saif stands a short distance away, smiling; mother remains visible near the bench. Warm afternoon left-window light. Upper 70% action, lower 30% calm.

pages.text: إِجَا دَوْرْ هَاشِمْ يِشُوتْ، وَسَيْفْ صَارْ الْحَارِسْ. رَاحِتْ الْكُرَة بَيْنْ رِجْلَيْنْ سَيْفْ وَفَاتِتْ الْمَرْمَى. هَاشِمْ نَطّْ نَطِّة صْغِيرَة: «هَدَفْ!» سَيْفْ صَفَّقْلُه وَضِحِكْ: «مَرَّقْتَهَا مِنْ تَحْتِي!»
pages.illustration_description: Wide action frame: Saif guards the complete low foam goal with feet apart; the single cream-and-teal football has rolled between his legs into it. Toddler Hashim makes a tiny hop while Saif applauds. Mother watches from the rear bench. Preserve window and goal orientation. Upper 70% action, lower 30% calm.

pages.text: قَعَدْ سَيْفْ جَنْبْ مَامَا، وَسَنَدْ رَاسُه عَكَتِفْهَا. هَاشِمْ حَضَنِ الْكُرَة وَتَمْتَمْ: «شُورْبِة إِنْدُومِي...» غَمَزْ سَيْفْ لِمَامَا، وَطَلَعِتْ مِنْهُمْ ضِحِكْة هَادْيِة.
pages.illustration_description: Quiet medium closing frame on the cream bench: Saif leans his head against mother's shoulder and shares an amused glance with her; Hashim hugs the one football and giggles beside them. The complete teal-and-gold foam goal rests on the mat nearby. Same warm afternoon. Upper 70% action, lower 30% calm.
